scenario.title: The customers who disappeared
scenario.contract: Return every customer once, with the number of their paid orders. Customers with no paid orders must appear with paid_orders = 0. Output customer_id, name, paid_orders. Preserve separate customers with the same name.

casePack.title: The customers who disappeared
casePack.contract: Return every customer once, with the number of their paid orders. Customers with no paid orders must appear with paid_orders = 0. Output customer_id, name, paid_orders. Preserve separate customers with the same name.
casePack.baselineSQL:
SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS paid_orders
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY c.id;
casePack.referenceSQL: SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS paid_orders FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.id;
